name: Calibration Dashboard
description: Logs every framework prediction to local SQLite with metadata (asset, phase, therapeutic area, modality, capital-position tier, predicted PoS, reflexivity multiplier). Resolved outcomes (manual or scripted from CT.gov / press releases) feed Brier-score aggregation by segment. The dashboard answers the question every VC asks: 'how do we know your model is calibrated?' Architecturally mirrors Archon's log_prediction / resolve_prediction / get_calibration_report pattern but is self-contained (no MCP dependency). v1.5 ships the discipline; v1.6+ accumulates the sample.
